name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Training Loop
definition: Per-image error: Compares one render against one photo. Scene-wide error is the loss averaged across all training views, used to monitor overall progress.
summary: The 3D Gaussian Splatting Training Loop is a stochastic gradient descent procedure that optimizes 3D Gaussian parameters via a differentiable rasterizer, distinguishing itself by computing explicit gradients to correct millions of parameters simultaneously.
